extension.summary: Logs what you finish watching in Kodi straight to your teamira diary
extension.description:
Watches Kodi's own playback events in the background and, once you've actually finished a movie or episode (not just started one), sends it to your teamira account automatically — no manual logging.
Set your teamira server URL and integration token in this addon's settings first (teamira app: Settings -> auto-tracking -> kodi).
Works best with a scraped library (TMDB/IMDB metadata attached); unscraped files still get logged, just as a plain title with no catalog match.
